fixed_statement:
Let the underlying matroid be \(U_{0,\{1,2,3\}}\oplus U_{2,4}\).

\(3\) loops strictly fail the strong map condition.
fixed_proof: The loop set \(\{1,2,3\}\) is contained in every closure in the direct sum, so adjoining \(4\) gives a closed flat \(\{1,2,3,4\}\). This matroid contains the closed flat \(\{1,2,3,4\}\), which is not a flat of \(F_7\). This set is not a flat of the Fano matroid.
reason: Moved the closed-flat contradiction argument out of the statement and removed the scaffold headers; the statement now contains only the matroid assumption and the claim.
